description: Lists the seller's campaigns (a campaign is a design applied to one or more products), newest first, with id, name, URL, status, dates, and products with selling price and colours.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging (default 0)

search.description: Text to look for in campaign name, id or URL

status.description: Only campaigns with this status (as returned in the status field)

name: list_campaigns
title: List my campaigns
